text:
mira: quick brain dump - I'm proposing a different angle for the approval flow: split risk into Behavioral (latency/errors), Economic (quota/cost), and Privacy (data egress). each axis maps to approver sets. goal: faster low-risk changes, clearer path for complex ones.

kevin: neat. how do we calculate the axes? are these heuristics from traffic sims or static rules?

jamal: prefer telemetry-driven heuristics. e.g., Behavioral = predicted p50 delta from routing change; Economic = delta in token burn / quota projection; Privacy = any path that touches non-whitelisted regions or external endpoints. thresholds can be tuned weekly.

mira: exactly. I'm thinking risk_score = weighted_sum(behavioral, economic, privacy) and then map to approver groups: score<0.2 => auto, 0.2-0.5 => owner or delegated approver, >0.5 => owner+SRE+Security. weights configurable per-team.

olivia: ux question: how do we show this in console? small stacked bar for the three axes, with a tooltip that explains what triggered the privacy flag. also show a suggested canary size and recovery window.

ops-bot: PRECHECK: schema ok, simulated_impact: p50_delta=8%, error_delta=0.2pp, quota_delta=1.5x, privacy_flag=true, risk_score=0.67, suggested_approvers=[\"SRE\",\"Security\"], suggested_canary=0.25%

kevin: ops-bot suggests 0.25% canary, we usually start lower for privacy-sensitive flows. default dry-run fraction should be 0.05% for privacy=true unless owner overrides with justification.

jamal: can we support tenant-sliced canaries? route the change to tenants with tag beta=true and under a quota threshold. that avoids noisy tenants and surfaces real-world behavior.

mira: tenant-sliced canaries makes sense. console needs a picker: sample by tenant tag, by region, or by percent. add validation: sampled tenants must be < 50 and never include top-10 revenue tenants unless explicitly allowed.

olivia: add a required free-text \"why\" when widening a canary or skipping dry-run. drives better audits.

ops-bot: SUGGESTION: include a machine-approver role for repeated low-risk ops (cron jobs) after N successful dry-runs. machine_approver=true will auto-approve similar future changes for 30d.

kevin: machine-approver is powerful but dangerous. restrict to owner-owned flags and only if privacy_flag=false and risk_score<0.15. require a heartbeat in audit logs.

jamal: on telemetry gates: propose 3 triggers for auto-rollback: p50 > baseline*1.4, errors > baseline + 1pp AND > 3x relative, quota burn > predicted*1.6. also add a behavioural window: 15m rolling for p50, 1h for errors.

mira: agree on windows. add egress_watch for privacy: any new external host or region contact during canary pauses rollout and creates a security ticket automatically.

olivia: for scheduled rollouts, console should display an explicit \"oncall notified\" checkbox and a timeline preview showing canary ramp steps. also show a link to a precomputed dashboard that has the canary slices highlighted.

ops-bot: ACTION: created infra-telemetry dashboard job #801 to produce the canary preview snapshots and add a canary marker layer.

kevin: API changes: new v2 fields: \"risk_axes\": [\"behavioral\",\"economic\",\"privacy\"], \"risk_score\": \"0.67\", \"canary_plan\": [ {\"step\": 1, \"fraction\": \"0.0005\", \"selector\": \"tenant_tag=beta\"}, ... ], \"machine_approver\": \"false\", \"audit_reason\": \"string\". keep v1 for simple toggles.

jamal: also add \"revert_token\" and store pre_apply_config_id so rollback is a single atomic apply with the id. ops playbook should document CLI: redwood config rollback --token <revert_token>.

mira: will add revert_token and playbook snippet. also adding the copy for the stacked bar ui. olivia can you draft the microcopy for the privacy tooltip?

olivia: on it. include short examples: \"privacy flag: routes to eu-central instead of us-west\" and an explicit note: \"dry-run default enforced for privacy=true\".

ops-bot: NOTE: audit-log schema will include fields [applier, approvers, machine_approver, risk_axes, dry_run_fraction, canary_plan, revert_token]. logs will be immutable and routed to secure-audit.

kevin: final question: delegated approvers for product-lite teams. can we allow team admins to nominate approver groups? needs SA check but helpful.

jamal: support group-based approvers, but include a cooldown for changes auto-approved by group: 24h observation before allowing broader rollouts.

mira: sounds good. i'll update the PR with tenant-sliced canary support, stacked bar UI, machine-approver safe-guards, and the v2 API. thanks all. please react :thumbsup: if you're good with the plan.

ops-bot: REMINDER: infra-telemetry will run a one-off shadow trace sim next week. RSVP in #eng-telemetry if you need custom traces.

kevin: +1

jamal: +1

olivia: +1

mira: merging the draft later today after adding olivia's copy and the audit log link.
